name: shader_d57960
vertexShader: attribute float aSize; attribute vec4 aCol; varying vec4 vC; uniform float uScale; void main(){ vC=aCol; vec4 mv=modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.); gl_PointSize=aSize*uScale/max(0.1,-mv.z); gl_Position=projectionMatrix*mv; }
fragmentShader: uniform sampler2D uMap; varying vec4 vC; void main(){ vec4 t=texture2D(uMap,gl_PointCoord); gl_FragColor=vec4(vC.rgb,vC.a*t.a); }
